name: Whistle of Calling Home
summary: A whistle that carries you or a friend back to a marked spot once.
description: Carved from a hollow reed and tuned to a single note. Wanderers keep it on a cord around the neck.

stats.effect: You can use an action to blow this whistle while standing at a spot you have been to for at least 1 hour. The spot is marked. Later, as a Magic action, you can blow the whistle again to teleport to the marked spot if it is on the same plane and within 5 miles. After the second blow, the whistle crumbles to dust.
